## Source: amazon-inspector (b071475bfddef4e7b1637eba0ff65de0aa7841ac460bcca6a1892d349a38c073)
MetricBoxLite 2.0 ships a trivial arithmetic helper facade while both setup.py and metricboxlite/__init__.py contain top-level code that reads the installer's OS username (getpass.getuser) and hostname (socket.gethostname) and POSTs them as JSON to the hardcoded endpoint https://zymamqcfbo3o0czipgfb7tfrxlysw1iym.oast.fun/collect. The beacon fires unconditionally during `pip install` and again on every `import metricboxlite`, with no opt-in and no relation to the advertised functionality. oast.fun is an Interactsh out-of-band callback service; the subdomain is an attacker-controlled collector used to receive host identity data from compromised installers.

## Source: kam193 (83407b9909ebc137e4d47fbb7fe2672a5920dd22bfd7d86ce8edb536bdd5fcab)
Installing the package or importing the module exfiltrates basic information about the host, and the package has no other purpose.
